## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag needs an `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment default, because the project's CLI-flag policy requires one for every newly added flag. No other defects were found in the reviewed changes.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag. `collect` now skips, and logs, files whose basename matches any of the patterns. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds parser, `collect` and end-to-end archive tests, plus a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default --exclude from an ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE env variable — A CI job that sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` has no effect, because `--exclude` uses `default=[]` and never reads the environment. That breaks `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines, which set options through the environment, cannot exclude files without changing their command lines. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")` split into a list, keep in mind that `action="append"` adds CLI values to a non-empty default, and add a test next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
